Strategy: Score is a V-shaped penalty centered where the bin residual equals twice the item size, with a steeper slope below the center than above, so the rule prefers bins that can still take another same-size item after placement. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin is much smaller than twice the item. It may help by preserving one more same-size slot, or fail when items rarely repeat.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - 2 * item) if r >= 2 * item else -2 * (2 * item - r)) for r in bins]
```
